name: CoinFlyToWallet
description: 金币从奖励弹窗弹起后沿弧线飞向右上角钱包，途中放大再缩小，抵达时淡出。
summary: UI 动效，单次 0.746 秒：路径 2 段，总长 905 px，属性变化 Scale、Alpha，事件 1 个；不循环。

conventions.space: All positions are offsets from the first path point; apply relative to the object's start position.
conventions.pathTiming: Each segment moves at constant speed along its arc length, shaped by the segment ease.
conventions.clipTiming: start = arrival time of anchor point + offset. A later clip on the same track overrides an earlier one; the earlier one is cut at the later one's start.
conventions.clipValue: scale: multiplier of initial localScale; rotation: euler delta added to initial; alpha/color: absolute 0-1. Each clip animates from the current value to its target.
conventions.ease: Ease names match DOTween's Ease enum with default overshoot 1.70158. Custom = AnimationCurve keys [time, value, inTangent, outTangent].
conventions.loop: count = number of plays (-1 = infinite). scope Whole repeats the entire motion. scope LastSegment plays once up to loop.start (the start time of the last path segment) and then repeats only [loop.start, duration], including clips and events in that range. Yoyo plays every other repeat backwards.
conventions.export: Optional. When this JSON is saved in a Unity project as <name>.motion.json, a C# class is generated next to it: export.className (default: <name> in PascalCase + "Motion") in export.namespace (default: global).
conventions.desc: One-sentence description of a segment, clip or event. descSource manual = written by the author; auto = generated from the data (ignored when the JSON is read back).
conventions.endTarget: If endTarget.bound is true, the last path point is only a design-time reference. At runtime take the bound object's position, convert it into this object's parent space (through screen space when endTarget.kind differs from target: a UI element via its canvas camera, a 3D object via the world camera; a 3D mover keeps its distance to the camera), giving actualEnd as an offset from the start. Then add (actualEnd - authoredEnd) * pathProgress to every evaluated position, where pathProgress is the travelled fraction of the total arc length (0 at the start, 1 at the end).

events.name: OnCoinArrive
events.desc: 0.746 秒触发事件 OnCoinArrive：coin arrived at wallet
